paths.description: Homepage and primary listing template; covers global chrome, consent, discovery and initial-load quality.
Homepage at narrow mobile width; covers reflow, zoom, target sizing and mobile accessibility.
Search-results and filtering journey for a representative query.
Representative media-detail template and listing-to-detail journey.
Account sign-in template, input assistance and account-flow trust.
Synthetic missing route to inspect HTTP/navigation failure recovery.

findings.summary: The desktop layout is forced into the mobile viewport.
findings.evidence: At 360x800, layout measured scrollWidth 1024px against clientWidth 360px, 664px horizontal overflow. The screenshot shows the left rail and clipped content instead of a reflowed mobile layout.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a genuinely responsive layout: remove fixed desktop minimum widths, collapse the left rail and top navigation, and use intrinsic/fluid sizing that fits 360 CSS pixels.

findings.summary: Loading shimmer animation continues under reduced motion.
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce emulated, document.getAnimations() returned eight running shimmer animations, each with a 2000ms duration.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable shimmer and other non-essential looping animation in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), replacing it with a static loading state.

findings.summary: A large consent overlay obscures the primary content on every fresh visit.
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots of the home and detail templates show the cookie panel centered over most primary content. DOM inspection found no dialog, popover, role=dialog or aria-modal semantics for this interruption.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep consent necessary and neutral, but implement it as an accessible dialog with labelled purpose, managed focus and non-obscuring presentation where legally possible.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP misses the good Core Web Vitals threshold.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.9s and scored performance 0.85. The independent trace was faster at 1.16s, indicating variable but materially slow throttled mobile loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP dependency chain, prioritise the LCP asset, and reduce render-blocking CSS and startup JavaScript.

findings.summary: Image sizing and delivery waste bytes and create avoidable stability risk.
findings.evidence: The image primitive found 29 of 36 images without explicit dimensions, 13 oversized, 8 below-fold images not lazy-loaded and 15 legacy-format resources. Lighthouse also flagged unsized images and estimated 21KiB image savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width/height or aspect-ratio, correct responsive srcset/sizes selection, lazy-load below-fold media, and prefer AVIF/WebP where supported.

findings.summary: Interactive controls and content structures have accessibility-tree defects.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility score was 0.75 and reported an unnamed button, accessible-name/visible-label mismatches on media cards, and invalid direct children inside a ul. The custom consent overlay had no dialog semantics.
findings.suggestedFix: Name every control, align visible and accessible names, repair list semantics, and expose modal state with a native dialog or equivalent complete semantics.

findings.summary: Important banner and metadata text fail WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found age-banner text at 2.15:1 and secondary banner text at 1.75:1 against green, plus repeated metadata text at 3.29:1 against the dark surface; expected minimum is 4.5:1 for this text.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust the green banner and muted text tokens to meet at least 4.5:1, and distinguish inline links with more than colour alone.

findings.summary: The mobile page prevents normal zoom and has undersized or crowded targets.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found user-scalable=no in the effective mobile viewport meta and target-size failures, including a 194x20 link. The 360px screenshot also fails reflow due to 664px overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no, preserve at least 5x zoom, make targets at least 24x24 CSS pixels with spacing, and fix mobile reflow.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS, but browser defenses and cookie flags are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers showed CSP limited to frame-ancestors, with no nosniff or Referrer-Policy. Cookie inspection found settings and x_csrf_token without Secure; settings also uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a full restrictive CSP, add nosniff and a suitable Referrer-Policy, and mark all HTTPS cookies Secure with the narrowest viable SameSite and HttpOnly settings.

findings.summary: The fresh load contacts a broad third-party surface before consent is chosen.
findings.evidence: The HAR captured 143 requests, 117 classified third-party and 1.65MB third-party transfer, including Google Accounts and an ad-syndication endpoint, while the consent overlay was still awaiting a choice. Tracker enumeration found 13 third-party origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential identity, advertising and analytics requests until consent; consolidate origins, batch telemetry and document each third party’s necessity.

findings.summary: The existing-password field advertises the wrong autocomplete purpose.
findings.evidence: On /login, the username input uses autocomplete=username but the sign-in password input uses autocomplete=new-password, which can obstruct password-manager autofill for returning users.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=current-password on login and retain username. Offer WebAuthn/passkeys alongside federated and password sign-in.

findings.summary: Rich media pages lack structured and social-preview metadata.
findings.evidence: Home DOM probes found zero JSON-LD blocks and no Open Graph metadata despite the page representing a large media listing; the inspected detail template likewise supplied no evidence of structured metadata in the retained DOM artifact.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject and collection/breadcrumb JSON-LD where applicable plus Open Graph/Twitter preview metadata matching visible content.

findings.summary: Localized variants are linked in-page but hreflang discovery signals are absent.
findings.evidence: The page exposes dozens of language/region variants, html lang is es-AR and canonical is present, but the link[rel=alternate] probe returned no hreflang entries. /sitemap.xml returned HTTP 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish reciprocal hreflang alternates for localized equivalents and expose sitemap locations consistently in robots.txt.

findings.summary: Startup JavaScript and third-party delivery are heavy for the listing shell.
findings.evidence: The load transferred 1.76MB across 143 requests; 62 scripts accounted for 1.01MB and one index bundle was 400KB. Lighthouse estimated 56KiB unused CSS, 26KiB unused JavaScript and 11KiB legacy JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a template budget, split and conditionally load the listing bundle, remove unused/legacy code, and defer non-critical third-party features.

findings.summary: Navigation swaps pages without declarative view-transition support.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection across the loaded styles found no view-transition rules or names, while browsing moved between separate listing, search and detail documents.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-origin cross-document view transitions for route changes, with a reduced-motion override and graceful fallback.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly exposed on key controls.
findings.evidence: Programmatic focus inspection found the search input and button with outline-style none, outline width 0 and no box-shadow; Lighthouse separately flagged target-size failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a high-contrast :focus-visible indicator for every interactive element and keep touch targets adequately sized and spaced.

taskList.title: Rebuild the narrow-screen layout and restore zoom/focus usability
Gate non-essential third parties until consent
Repair accessible names, semantics and contrast
Harden CSP, headers and cookie flags
Correct login autocomplete and add passkey support
Publish hreflang and rich media metadata
